description.value: You can incorporate healing elixirs into your alchemical bombs as submunitions. As part of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Quick Alchemy] to create the bomb, you expend a second versatile vial to create a common alchemical elixir with the healing trait that you could create with Quick Alchemy. If you succeed at a Strike with the bomb, a willing ally within 5 feet of the target gains the benefits of activating the elixir and is temporarily immune to splash damage from the bomb for that Strike.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
